name: metis-mcp
description: Registers the Métis MCP server: 58 read-only tools over the behaviour graph and the knowledge in it — the model and its validation, coverage and what could not be measured, traceability and where the chain breaks, the test cases a model would produce, what a change touches, the specification and requirements, an authoring surface that states the accepted space rather than a value, and a risk toolkit whose arithmetic needs no graph at all — including a requirement and a release assessment that declare what Métis gathered and what a person must still answer. Read-only by DEFAULT and by construction at that tier (§9.5, N-8): the write modules are never imported, so no decision can be taken through this surface. Setting METIS_MCP_WRITE adds landing and, separately, the gates — each costing an identity, the evidence fingerprint and a literal word. Requires a running Métis server and a Neo4j graph.
